summary: Frontend-only verification of App Lock PIN change from 4-6 digits to strict 4 digits. All UI/behavior changes verified successfully: (a) modal title 'Set App Lock PIN' shown, (b) hint text is EXACTLY 'Choose a 4 digit PIN. You'll need this to unlock the app.' with no '4-6'/'4–6' occurrences, (c) exactly 4 dots rendered (not 6) in setup modal, (d) auto-transition to 'Confirm PIN' phase fires strictly at the 4th digit, (e) Confirm phase shows hint 'Re-enter the same PIN to confirm' with 4 dots, (f) mismatch (1234 vs 5678) shows pin-error 'PINs don't match. Try again.' and resets back to 'Set App Lock PIN' phase, (g) Cancel button closes the modal without enabling. AppLockGate.tsx code inspection confirms the unlock screen also renders 4 dots and reset-with-shake feedback triggers at length>=4. appLock.ts regex is strictly /^\d{4}$/. Note: an out-of-scope side observation — on web preview finalizePinSetup shows 'Failed to save PIN. Try again.' after matching PINs (likely SecureStore.setItemAsync limitation on web); this is unrelated to the 4-6→4 change and does not affect the review verification.

integration_issues.flow: Profile → App Lock enable → PIN setup finalize (web preview only)
integration_issues.issue: After entering matching 4-digit PIN (1234+1234), pin-error shows 'Failed to save PIN. Try again.' and modal remains open. Root cause: setPin() returns false because expo-secure-store SecureStore.setItemAsync throws/rejects on this web preview environment. Not caused by the PIN-length change; strictly a SecureStore-on-web limitation. Not testable on native Expo Go/device. Consider adding a web fallback (AsyncStorage/localStorage) or gating App Lock enablement to native platforms.

action_items: None required for the reviewed PIN-length change — all acceptance criteria pass.

Optional (out of scope): Add a web fallback for SecureStore in src/utils/appLock.ts (or hide/disable the App Lock toggle on Platform.OS === 'web') so users on web preview can either use App Lock or see a clearer explanation instead of the 'Failed to save PIN' error.
critical_code_review_comments: appLock.ts setPin uses strict /^\d{4}$/ — matches PRD.
AppLockGate.tsx pressDigit uses .slice(0,4) and verifies at length>=4, dots row renders [0,1,2,3] — matches PRD.
profile.tsx pressPinDigit auto-transitions at next.length === 4 in 'set' phase and hint text is 'Choose a 4 digit PIN…' — matches PRD.
profile.tsx dots row renders [0,1,2,3] — matches PRD.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for PIN-length change scope (6/6 acceptance items pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PIN-length change (4-6 → strict 4 digits) is fully verified via Playwright at 390x844 mobile viewport on http://localhost:3000 with Continue as Guest. testIDs used: row-app-lock, pin-digit-0..9, pin-backspace, pin-cancel, pin-error. Unrelated web-only issue: SecureStore.setItemAsync appears to fail on web preview causing setPin() → false → 'Failed to save PIN. Try again.' after a matching confirm. This is pre-existing web platform limitation, not part of this change.
rca_of_issue: N/A for the reviewed change — all pass. Side observation RCA: On web, expo-secure-store may not persist reliably; setPin() catches the error and returns false → finalizePinSetup shows 'Failed to save PIN. Try again.'. Reproduction: enable App Lock in Profile on web preview → enter 1234 → confirm 1234 → error appears. Mitigation: platform-guard the toggle on web or fallback to AsyncStorage on Platform.OS === 'web'.
